description: The customer's bank account has insufficient balance to complete the transaction.
official_next_step: Prompt the customer to check their account balance or use an alternative bank account / payment method.

description: The Virtual Payment Address (VPA / UPI ID) entered by the customer is invalid, inactive, or incorrectly formatted.
official_next_step: Prompt the customer to re-enter a valid and active VPA (e.g., username@bank) or select a saved UPI handle.

description: The customer entered an incorrect UPI PIN (MPIN) during authorization on their PSP app.
official_next_step: Ask the customer to retry the transaction and enter the correct 4 or 6-digit UPI PIN.

description: The customer explicitly declined or dismissed the collect request in their UPI application.
official_next_step: Notify the customer that the payment was cancelled and send a new payment link.

description: The transaction amount exceeds the customer's per-transaction limit set by their bank or NPCI UPI guidelines.
official_next_step: Advise the customer to split the payment across smaller tranches or complete settlement via NEFT/RTGS using Corporate VAN.

description: The customer's VPA / UPI ID has been blocked or restricted due to risk rules, repeated failed attempts, or bank hold.
official_next_step: Prompt customer to contact their issuing bank to unblock UPI services or provide an alternate UPI ID / bank transfer.

description: The customer has reached their bank's daily cumulative UPI transaction limit (e.g. ₹1,00,000 / 24-hr cap).
official_next_step: Advise the customer to retry after 24 hours or execute instant bank transfer via NEFT/IMPS.

description: The customer's bank core banking system or UPI switch is temporarily down for maintenance or experiencing downtime.
official_next_step: Check bank downtime status and prompt the customer to retry in 15-30 minutes or select an account from another bank.

description: The UPI collect request or intent session timed out before the customer completed authorization on their UPI app.
official_next_step: Advise the customer to initiate a fresh payment request and approve the notification promptly within the validity window.

description: NPCI central UPI switch or payment service provider (PSP) network was unreachable during transaction routing.
official_next_step: Wait a few moments and retry. If issue persists across PSPs, route payment via alternative rails.

description: The collect request expiry timer (typically 5 to 10 minutes) elapsed without customer action.
official_next_step: Re-trigger a dynamic UPI intent link with fresh payment parameters.

description: Downstream debit from remitter account could not be confirmed by the remitter bank CBS.
official_next_step: Verify account statement to ensure amount was not debited before triggering an instant retry.
